coverage: WDK Release build links HibikiVirtualAudio.sys and Inf2Cat signability reports zero errors/zero warnings
no C4996 deprecation warning from the pool allocator call site (suppressed with documented rationale)
no C4189 unused-variable warning in GetHWLatency; CodecDelay now reports the FIFO latency estimate

changes.summary: Collapse duplicate NonPagedPoolNx branch and suppress C4996 at the tagged allocator call site with a documented NTDDI_VERSION upgrade path.
GetHWLatency now assigns HWLatency->CodecDelay from the computed 100 ns latency estimate instead of leaving it unused.

limitations: Source/build evidence only: no guest install/load, physical endpoint, HLK, or Microsoft-signing claim.
ExAllocatePoolWithTag remains deprecated upstream; full migration to ExAllocatePool2 requires a coordinated NTDDI_VERSION bump to Win11 constants and is intentionally out of scope for this slice.
CodecDelay now reflects an estimate derived from frames_per_buffer and sample_rate; it is not a measured hardware delay.
